apps.message:
feat(listing): every finding as a task; an explicit cutoff only past GitHub's limit

## Intent

The listing results comment showed at most 50 findings in rule order and then only a count, so rules whose findings fell past the cap never appeared. Every finding must be visible, or the cutoff must be explicit and link the full report.

## Key changes

- Every finding is a task, grouped by rule: the rule id linked to its page and the severity; where, found and fix stay in a code block, since the reports are data from the pull request.
- Only a comment above 60,000 bytes is cut off. It then says how many findings it shows of how many, lists every rule with its count, shows the same number of findings for every rule, and links the full report attached to the run.
- The comment is rewritten on every run, so ticked boxes start empty again.

moved.why: The time cut held two unrelated requests: the site rules and the cutoff of the listing comment; this commit serves the second.
